The shared ring is already cyan/on-register; fracturing the single focus identity per-primitive would be inconsistent. Resting state fully sd-tokenized. Motion classes (animate-in/fade-in/zoom/slide-in-from-*) are INERT app-wide: no tailwindcss-animate / tw-animate-css plugin is imported and it is not a dep, so none of these compile to CSS (pre-existing, all non-fence components use them too). glassyTileShadow() kept for API stability but returns 'none' (glow/halo retired, §16); NEUMORPHIC_TILE is now a flat sd plate. Exported names preserved so insights consumers restyle for free.
